literal: To embrace the world is wisdom; that which has neither expanding nor contracting is true wisdom.
translation: To live in harmony with the world is wisdom; true wisdom is to remain equanimous, free from both elation and depression.
modern: உலகத்தோடு பொருந்தி வாழ்வதே சிறந்த அறிவாகும்; இன்ப துன்பங்களால் மன விரிவோ அல்லது மனச் சுருக்கமோ அடையாமல் சமமாக இருப்பதே உண்மையான அறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines wisdom through two key concepts: harmony and equanimity. First, 'ஒட்பம்' (mental clarity) is shown as 'உலகம் தழீஇயது', which means embracing and living in harmony with the people of the world. Second, true 'அறிவு' (wisdom) is described as having neither 'மலர்தல்' (expanding or blooming with joy/elation) nor 'கூம்பல்' (contracting or closing with grief/depression). A truly wise person maintains a steady, balanced mind regardless of changing fortunes.
